allowances.reason: Tracked as J55 / AUD3-11: real GCP's REST Cluster schema exposes an output-only bootstrapAddress and the emulator serves it, but the pinned cloud.google.com/go/managedkafka proto has no Cluster.bootstrap_address (v1.2.0, the latest tagged release, is field-identical; also absent from googleapis / google-cloud-go main), so a typed gRPC client cannot receive the field (internal/gcp/transport/grpc/managedkafka/transcode.go). Closed as no fix: an upstream-proto gap, not a state divergence (both transports share one core); revisit when the published proto gains the field (canary: TestPinnedProtoLacksBootstrapAddress).

Same J55 / AUD3-11 upstream-proto gap as GetCluster: the pinned managedkafka proto has no Cluster.bootstrap_address, so the gRPC list omits the REST field. The list is scoped to the run suffix, so element [0] is this run's single cluster.
